data.one_liner: Flexible dropdown list package supporting single, search, multiple, and radio selections.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized dropdown widgets that work with simple model lists. It supports single selection, single selection with search, multiple selection, and radio button selection options.
use_when: You need dropdown selection widgets that bind easily to custom object models.
You require search functionality within single or multi-select dropdown lists.
avoid_when: You need standard Material DropdownButton components without external custom widgets.
strengths: Supports multiple selection, search, and radio button styles out of the box.
Easy to integrate with custom model lists via option item wrappers.
weaknesses: Limited to the specific UI styles and features provided by the package.
